title: China Obstetrics and Gynecology Journal Club
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine if an intensive journal club based on articles and materials provided on the journal Obstetrics and Gynecology Website improves written and spoken comprehension of medical English in a population of Chinese medical professionals.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Chinese medical professional

Exclusion Criteria:

* English speaking fluency
* Non-Chinese speaking medical professional
